Name: Money Sinks - Golden Statues
Author: Nullnnow
Description:
Tired of Lewis having a monopoly on golden statues? Want to build a shrine to someone? Well this mod's got you covered! Introducing the first mod in my "Money Sinks" mod series, a series of mods aiming to add more options to spend money on for when you reach end game. This mod adds 2 statues for each giftable NPC (excluding Lewis), one that unlocks at 8 hearts and one that unlocks at 10 hearts.

Statues can be purchased from Old Master Cannoli! To access his shop, interact with the pillar next to him (or the flowers next to him if you are playing SVE).

Want these statues but aren't interested in grinding millions of gold? No problem! The configuration file allows you to specify how expensive you want the statues to be!

[size=4]Obtaining the Golden Morris Statue[/size]
In order to obtain the Golden Morris statue without CJB Item Spawner, you need to install the optional "Morris Spawner" mod. Once installed, the Golden Morris statue can be found
[spoiler]behind the JojaMart sign.[/spoiler]
